lines.text: The root is Pos! Positive, propose.
Did you know? Pos is Latin for put.
Positive: put firmly, so sure or good.
Quick quiz! Which means forward plus put?

words.mean: put firmly, so sure or good
words.ex: She always has a positive attitude.
I propose that we meet again next week.
